claims.text: Steel portal frames are generally low-rise structures with columns and horizontal or pitched rafters joined by moment-resisting connections.
A portal frame resists lateral and vertical actions through member bending stiffness and rigid or moment-resisting joints, often with haunches at high-moment regions.

source_refs.locator: Single-storey steel buildings Part 4: Detailed Design of Portal Frames
Engineering students' guide to single storey buildings

claims.text: Portal-frame scheme cards should capture system form, primary frame spacing, haunch assumptions, secondary members, and stability system assumptions before detailed member checks.

limitations: The card does not encode plastic design, second-order analysis, fire, crane, or robustness design procedures.
Use region-specific design sources before converting this overview into check inputs.
